aiDevelopment.lead: We use AI-enabled development tools, including AI-powered coding agents, as part of our everyday development workflow, not as a gimmick.

features.title: Cleaner, More Consistent Code

features.title: Faster Development, Without Cutting Corners

features.title: Stronger Security From the Start

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Clear answers to common questions about our web design, custom engineering, and AI-assisted workflows.

items.question: What does FuduGo offer in web design and development?
items.answer: FuduGo provides custom web design and development, e-commerce website development, website maintenance and support, and related graphic design, video editing, and branding services.

items.question: Can FuduGo build a custom website from scratch?
items.answer: Yes. FuduGo can design and develop websites around a business's specific requirements, functionality, audience, and objectives rather than relying solely on predefined templates.

items.question: Does FuduGo use AI for website development?
items.answer: Yes. FuduGo uses AI-assisted coding tools to help developers with code suggestions, programming logic, implementation tasks, problem-solving, and identifying potential issues during development.

items.question: Does AI build the entire website?
items.answer: No. AI is used selectively as a development assistant. FuduGo's developers remain responsible for architecture, project requirements, business logic, code review, testing, and final implementation.

items.question: Can you add AI features to my website?
items.answer: Yes, where AI provides a meaningful business or user benefit. Potential applications include intelligent search, recommendations, business insights, automation, and other AI-powered functionality.
